messages:
julie: quick heads-up from onboarding run: reranker output was scrambled after switching to the new embeddings endpoint. lots of near-duplicate docs floating to top. error in app: "EmbeddingDimMismatch: expected 1024 got 2560"

omar: ouch. which SDKs and sampleapp?

julie: our Node sampleapp + a centralized go retriever service. API returned 2560-dim vectors (model updated), node-sdk surfaced field as `embeds` (array), but the go retriever expects `embedding` and has a batch-merge path that normalizes to a hard-coded 1024 for historical reasons. merge path truncates when retry merges occur.

vince: any auth or retry events? those usually trigger merge edge cases.

ci-bot: [2188889999] 401 Unauthorized POST /v1/embeddings req=req-77
ci-bot: [2188890001] token refresh ok
ci-bot: [2188890002] retry POST /v1/embeddings req=req-77 -> 200

omar: classic concurrency+parity bug. Node retried as a separate request which produced duplicate candidate rows; Go merged the retry into an in-flight batch and applied the truncate/pad logic which corrupted vectors. Also discovered a third variation: some internal clients send `vector_bytes` as base64-encoded floats which the go helper decodes into a different layout if misunderstood.

julie: pasted redacted API snippet we got back:
```
{"id":"d1","embeds":[0.0001,0.0002,...(2560 floats)...],"model":"vec-2560"}
```
and the go retriever seen shape after its parsing step (redacted log):
```
{id: "d1", embedding: [0.0001,0.0002,...(1024 floats)...]} // truncated during merge
```

vince: proposal: 1) make batcher preserve raw embedding payloads until a dedicated validation step (no silent truncation/padding), 2) add an opt-in STRICT_EMBED_DIM env that fails fast if dims differ, 3) require an Idempotency-Key header for retries so retried requests are deduped by request id before ingestion, 4) canonicalize the SDK surface to always expose resp.data[i].embedding as float[] and have SDKs handle `embeds`, `vector_bytes`, `vectors` behind the scenes.

omar: +1. Also recommend adding a short compatibility test in CI that simulates 401->refresh->retry for embeddings to ensure no duplicate insertion and no silent truncation.

julie: i'll open a tiny sampleapp patch to: set EXPECTED_EMBED_DIM in env, validate dims client-side, and attach Idempotency-Key on retry. will also add a fallback parser for `embeds` -> `embedding`.

vince: i'll update go retriever: stop truncating on merge, keep raw payloads until validation, map `embeds` -> `embedding` in parser, and add STRICT_EMBED_DIM=false default. opening PR now (wip).

ci-bot: [2188890042] ping: created issue platform#4770 label=devex/embeddings (cross-sdk dim parity + retry merge tests)

julie: short-term workaround snippet for teams to paste into sampleapps:
```
// Node workaround
const raw = resp?.data?.[0]?.embedding || resp?.data?.[0]?.embeds || decodeBase64(resp?.data?.[0]?.vector_bytes);
if (!raw || raw.length !== Number(process.env.EXPECTED_EMBED_DIM)) throw new Error(`bad dim ${raw?.length}`);
client.defaults.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = requestId;
```

omar: also adding a lint rule in retriever repo: warn if batcher code calls truncate/pad before an explicit validation step.

vince: PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/retriever-go/pull/115 (defer-validate-preserve-raw + map embeds->embedding), github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/529 (node: strict-dim + idempotency). ci-bot shows early tests passing.

devex-bot: [2188890048] noted. will add a short onboarding FAQ item: "Model dims changed? verify EXPECTED_EMBED_DIM and enable STRICT_EMBED_DIM for rerank-critical flows."

julie: thanks all. moving to follow-up backlog. will add unit tests that inject `vector_bytes` base64 variants and simulate retry merges. :rocket:
